question: Who is beating Veo 3 — and letting you generate for free?

inspiration.note: 211K views. Reference = lead only. Their delivery: cinematic AI footage opens the short (the claim is proven before named), then a browser recording of the Artificial Analysis Video Arena leaderboard, then a 'click to watch' CTA end card. Taken as principles: promise-proof order (see it before you hear it), leaderboard receipt with highlighting, end on an action. Their footage and wording stay theirs. hook_visual.intent: leaderboard already on screen at t=0 with the #1 row highlighted; the Elo number counts up as the two beaten names sit beneath — the leaderboard IS the hook, a receipt not a promise

points.claim: ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 tops the independent Artificial Analysis Video Arena leaderboard for text-to-video — Elo ~1,269 — ahead of Veo 3 (~1,226) and Sora 2, in blind human voting.
points.spoken: There is a leaderboard where people vote on AI videos without knowing which model made them. ByteDance's Seedance sits on top — above Veo three and Sora two.
points.source_note: buildfastwithai (Mar 2026): 'Seedance 2.0 hit Elo 1,269 on Artificial Analysis, beating Veo 3, Sora 2, and Runway Gen-4.5... blind user voting.' Artificial Analysis is independent; say 'blind voting', not self-reported benchmarks.

points.title: It beat the giants blind
points.sub: Seedance 2.0 tops Artificial Analysis T2V at ~1,269 Elo — above Veo 3 and Sora 2.

points.claim: It generates at up to 2K resolution with lip-sync, and clips run up to about 15 seconds.
points.spoken: The output is two-K, runs up to fifteen seconds a clip, and talking heads get proper lip sync — the thing most video models still fumble.
points.source_note: NivaaLabs hands-on review (Apr 2026): max resolution 2K, max clip ~15 s, 'joint audio-video generation produces the most natural lip sync' vs Veo 3 and Sora 2.

visual.intent: a spec strip builds across a playing portrait clip: 2K badge, 15s badge, waveforms under a talking face syncing — REAL screen recording of the tool/page (interface on screen, house heading + captions over it)

points.title: 2K, 15 seconds, lip-synced
points.sub: Joint audio+video generation — talking heads sync; clips to 15 s at 2K.

points.claim: You can try it free inside CapCut today; the API runs about $0.14 per 15-second clip.
points.spoken: Here is the part the title means: it is free inside CapCut right now. No credit card for a start. If you build on it, the API is fourteen cents per clip.
points.source_note: heyuan110 review (Mar 2026): 'Free in CapCut, roughly $0.14 per 15-second clip via API.' CapCut is ByteDance-owned, same family as Seedance — say it, it explains the free tier.

visual.intent: CapCut window with the video-model picker; a FREE stamp lands; then a tiny price tag: $0.14 / 15s clip — REAL screen recording of the tool/page (interface on screen, house heading + captions over it)

points.title: Free in CapCut today
points.sub: CapCut is ByteDance's own editor (same family); API is ~$0.14 per 15-second clip.

catch: Access outside China can be messy, and ByteDance's own video benchmark is self-reported — trust only the independent Artificial Analysis numbers, and remember CapCut sends your prompts to ByteDance servers.
catch_sub: Access outside China is spotty; ByteDance's own benchmarks are self-reported — only Artificial Analysis numbers are independent.

steps: Artificial Analysis is the independent one
